Container.Name: livepremier-plus
Container.Overview:
Adds a VPU resource map, a lighting-desk command line, a theatre cue stack, MIDI control-surface mapping and arithmetic in numeric fields to an Analog Way LivePremier's own Web RCS. Point it at a switcher and browse to it instead of to the device; it proxies the vendor interface and injects the extra panels, so it contains no part of Analog Way's software.
Note: Point it at a switcher and open it in any browser. hasOwnDocker because the Dockerfile is hand-written: this app has no build step and no dist/, and it needs a /config volume for cue stacks and the remembered device. Bridge networking is deliberate — it discovers nothing and makes one outbound connection to the address you type. It DOES write to the switcher (cue takes, preset recalls, MIDI moves), unlike aquilon-vpu-map.
